turnover_convention: L_box/npeak divided by the previous stationary mass-weighted 3D turbulent rms speed
initial_velocity: Fresh centered, solenoidal field with the same parabolic k=1..3 mode distribution as forcing, independent draw; uniform initial density and thermal pressure.
spectrum: Unweighted velocity, subtract volume mean, half squared Fourier amplitudes in nearest-integer shells. Equal shell weights in RMS log ratio of block-mean powers.
threshold: Stationary hot-start control. Use complete one-turnover blocks starting at t=20. Compute the 95th percentile of distances of each control block to the mean of the other control blocks; compare warm blocks to the full control mean.
energy: Absolute deviation of measured cooling over injected work from unity per block; split boundary-crossing fine increments in proportion to overlap.
timing: Report start of first run of three passing one-turnover blocks, confirmation at the end of the third. Also count later failures.
